items.name: use-table-state
items.title: useTableState
items.description: URL-synced table state hook: page, pageSize, sort, dir, search query, and arbitrary filters. Makes every table shareable and bookmarkable; pass straight into a server-side fetcher.

items.name: stat-card
items.title: StatCard
items.description: KPI card with value, label, optional trend (up/down/neutral with coloured arrow), icon slot, sparkline slot, and a built-in loading skeleton. Drop a row of these on every dashboard.
